text:
maya_support: Urgent handoff — ticket P-2345 escalated from Support to CS. Onboarding for a large account is blocked by SSO failures and a recent perf regression. Workshop scheduled tomorrow; renewal in ~6 weeks. Need CS prioritization and a comms plan.

maya_support: Key facts:
- Issue: SAML assertion rejected intermittently, 403 from our auth service.
- Customer wants SAML/SCIM, no API key option.
- Observed latency spikes during auth flow (~sustained 200-400ms increase).

maya_support: Error snippet:
```
2026-04-20T15:02:03Z auth-service ERROR AssertionConsumerService - invalid_meta: missing EntityDescriptor/ID
Stack: at saml/processor.go:78
```

sam_cs: On it. Scheduling a triage now. @ira_se can you join? Also need previous enablement notes and any CRM flags.

ira_se: I can join 11:30 PT. Runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sso. Send the full SAML trace.

maya_support: Pasting the last 3 traces above and attached full logs to the support ticket. Also customer notes they updated IdP yesterday.

alex_cs: I'll draft the comms: acknowledgement, quick workaround, and ETA. Recommend we pause any renewal outreach until we have a customer-facing note. Will share draft in 30m.

deploy-bot: Incident P-2345 created; page sent to oncall.

sam_cs: Priority = high. Proposed plan: 1) 2-day timebox to unblock SSO; 2) provide temporary migration window with a manual acceptance flow (if customer agrees); 3) escalate to eng for hotfix. @account_manager please prep for a sensitive renewal conversation if needed.

maya_support: Customer is strict about keys — they will not accept API keys. They require SAML fix or a SCIM-based workaround. No temp tokens.

ira_se: Reproducing locally. Looks like IdP is sending an EntityDescriptor with an extra xmlns attribute causing our parser to reject. We can add a tolerant parser shim as a hotfix. ETA: ~18 hours for a small patch + QA if we can ship a focused build; otherwise provide transformation middleware as workaround (2-3 hours to stand up).

alex_cs: Draft for customer message (short):
"Hi — thanks for flagging. We're investigating SSO failures and have a workaround to avoid blocking onboarding. We'll follow up with an ETA for a fix by end of day tomorrow and a safe migration plan. Apologies for the disruption. — Alex"

sam_cs: Send that to me for signoff, then we'll route to CS manager and legal if needed. Also flag the account as 'at-risk' in CRM and attach the ticket.

maya_support: Attaching ticket link and logs to this thread. Also adding the workshop holder to the invite so we can present the workaround during the session.

sam_cs: Setting a daily 09:00 sync until resolved. @ira_se, please update this thread with repro steps and the patch PR when available.

ira_se: Will do. Starting the shim branch now.

alex_cs: Commence outreach after sam_cs signoff. I'll include the workaround steps and an optional rollback plan.

sam_cs: Thanks all. Keeping renewals team paused for now. :thumbsup:
